title: Jets' Mason Taylor 'excited' to play alongside Kenyon Sadiq: 'We're building something special in that tight end room'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jets' Mason Taylor 'excited' to play alongside Kenyon Sadiq: 'We're building something special in that tight end room'
sources.description: Jets second-year tight end Mason Taylor believes in the team's vision with drafting Kenyon Sadiq in the first round of the 2026 NFL Draft.
